reviews.name: Karan Pareek
reviews.review: I had a wonderful experience learning German at “Gyanshala Foreign Language Academy”. The classes were well-structured, engaging, and easy to understand. Special thanks to Dillip Sir for his guidance, patience, and constant support. I truly appreciate his efforts and highly recommend this institute to anyone learning German.

reviews.name: Anjali Choudhary
reviews.review: Seit einem Jahr lerne ich Deutsch und glücklicherweise habe ich meine B1 Prüfung bestanden🏆🏆 . Zurzeit lerne ich B2 Kurs...Ich sammle hier viele Erfahrungen und das Umfeld des Unterrichts ist auch aüßerst einwandfrei und die Lehrer sind auch sehr hilfreich und unterstüztend uns beim Problem...Ich empfehle allen das Gyanshala institute zu beitreten

reviews.name: Jhanvi Kumawat
reviews.review: The German classes here are very interactive and practical. I like how the teachers focus on speaking from day one, instead of just theory. The sessions are fun, and I always feel motivated to practice more at home. It’s a perfect institute for beginners who want to learn German seriously.

reviews.name: Richa Singh
reviews.review: I recently finished my German classes here and I have to say, the faculty is amazing. They really know their stuff and have a deep and thorough Knowledge of the German language. Instead of just making you memorize a textbook, they actually break down tricky grammar and sentence structures so it's easier to grasp the concepts. The teachers are super supportive and patient whenever you get stuck. They are incredible and respond whenever you need help. Definitely recommend.

reviews.name: Suraj Dhayal
reviews.review: Gyanshala Foreign Language Academy is a finest institute in Lalkothi Jaipur for learning German language. The teachers are very supportive and hardworking. They are always ready to help you. The environment of the institute is very rich. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Ramjhan Chhimpa
reviews.review: I joined German language classes in Jaipur here and I must say the teaching quality is very good. The faculty is supportive, friendly, and always ready to clear doubts. The classes are interactive with lots of speaking practice, which makes learning enjoyable. Overall, a great place to improve German.

reviews.name: Suvidhi Loonker
reviews.review: I had an incredible experience at this German coaching institute! The faculty members are extremely knowledgeable, approachable, and genuinely dedicated to ensuring each student’s success. The learning atmosphere is positive, supportive, and highly conducive to acquiring language skills. Whether you’re a beginner or looking to refine your knowledge, this institute provides the perfect balance of structured teaching and practical exercises. I wholeheartedly recommend it to anyone looking for a top-tier German language learning experience.

reviews.name: Shivam Tak
reviews.review: Gyanshala is actually having some quality teaching and support toward student. It is a really very good experience. All the details covered by faculty is really great. Every smallest information was well explained by faculty. I am really thankful to Gyanshala teachers for making German language so easy to learn and understand.

reviews.name: Jatin Sharma
reviews.review: The Gyanshala Foreign Language Academy is an excellent place to learn languages. I am currently doing the English spoken course here, and I have seen a lot of improvement in myself. The teachers are knowledgeable, experienced, and very supportive with a friendly attitude. Thanks to their guidance, I can now speak English more fluently and confidently.

reviews.name: Deepak Chaudhary
reviews.review: I recently completed a course at Gyanshala academy, and I must say it exceeded my expectations. The instructors were not only highly knowledgeable but also incredibly patient, catering to the varying skill levels of each student with tailored teaching methods. The curriculum was well-structured, covering all aspects of the language from grammar to conversational skills, and the small class sizes ensured ample opportunity for interaction and practice. Overall, I highly recommend Gyanshala Academy Institute to anyone looking to master the language effectively and enjoyably.

reviews.name: Khushi Sharma
reviews.review: I would 100% recommend this institute for all learners. I am learning German here and my experience here is just so amazing. Teachers and the whole environment is so good. Dilip sir and Ashweer sir are brilliant and fantastic teachers. They support and understand students and are the most helpful. This institute provide the best nurturing environment. Anyone who needs guidance for studying abroad and learning foreign language must attend here. Tested and recommend institute.

reviews.name: Akshat Pandey
reviews.review: I started learning German here exact 1 year before and now I have completed B2 certification. From the level A1 to B2 I had the most amazing experience here while studying and interacting with others. Teachers here have very deep knowledge about everything like getting job in the German field, studying abroad and Techniques for the slow learners.

reviews.name: Rahul Soni
reviews.review: Das ist ein schönes Institut und die Lehrer sind nett und hilfreich. Ich empfehle das Institut für alle, die Deutsch in Jaipur lernen wollen.

reviews.name: Lavesh Rajput
reviews.review: GYANSHALA is a great place to learn foreign languages, where you get a healthy environment and great support from the staff. Their personalised attention to their students help to learn even faster. Well equipped digital classroom, interaction with natives and supportive faculty are also a very big support to the students. Coming to the career guidance and counseling, it is also a strong side of Gyanshala.

reviews.name: Jayalaxmi
reviews.review: Had an excellent experience here. The teachers are well qualified. It made learning german easy. This institute is highly recommended to everyone who wishes to learn any foreign language.

reviews.name: Shailja Rathore
reviews.review: Wenn jemand in Jaipur deutsch lernen möchte, der am Gyanshala Institut einmal besuchen soll. Die Lehrer sind sehr hilfreich und freundlich. Das Lernen am Gyanshala fühlt nie schwer, sondern genießt man die Atmosphäre!

reviews.name: Veronica Velasco
reviews.review: I had a fantastic experience learning German at Gyanshala Foreign Language Academy with Mr. Dilip Sinsinwar. Thanks to his excellent teaching methods and patient guidance, I was able to complete the A1 level in a short period of time. Mr. Sinsinwar made the lessons engaging and easy to understand, which greatly helped in building my confidence with the language. The academy provides a supportive learning environment, and I highly recommend it to anyone looking to learn German quickly and effectively. Vielen Dank, Mr. Sinsinwar and Gyanshala!

reviews.name: Sanju Punia
reviews.review: Best german language institute in jaipur. I am from Haryana and joined here for B1 and B2 level. I am learning from Disha Mam and found the class best among all the classes I've taken earlier in Jaipur as well as Delhi. For students interested in studying or working in Germany, the academy offers counseling services, assistance with university admissions, visa applications, and information on job opportunities within its network. Supporting staff, positive environment. Highly recommended! ✅✨
